explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/466: Graham proved N(X, 1/10) > (log X)/10. N(X,δ) is the max number of points in a closed disc of radius X with every pairwise distance at least δ from the nearest integer. This is finite, since distances are ≥ δ. The statement asserts the bound for all X ≥ 1, which matches the page's unqualified claim; for X < e^{10} it is trivial since N ≥ 1. Faithful.
